new_claim: An exact R2 repartition removes the derivative of the auxiliary constraint defect. The algebraic recovery bracket exceeds 1-2e-8 in the stated neighborhood. The frame scalar row has mixed source bound 1e-27 N2 and cold value <2e-17 conditional on N2(h_E)<=1.
hypothesis_audit: The total action, fixed couplings, scale, state and actual paired Dirac domain are unchanged by adding and subtracting the same local R2 functional and its boundary completion.
Without the repartition, the auxiliary constraint defect has an epsilon Box C term; no positive-mass argument removes it.
Constraint recovery is algebraic only within the explicit near-background branch; this is not a proved nonlinear solution ball.
The matched quantum vacuum is kept in the local potential split exactly, and the actual frame coefficient difference is retained.
The quantum functional remains evaluated on the original metric argument with its pulled-back domain; conformal covariance does not remove the anomaly or the nonlocal metric equation.
The nonconstant seed, density contacts, magnetic source variation and local charged terms are retained in the mixed bound.

N2 is an explicit weighted two-derivative metric input norm on regular fixed-period directions in the pulled-back physical fast phase. It does not itself impose endpoint data. No old energy bound is relabeled as N2.
The auxiliary cold result is a value estimate. Raw C5, complete metric admission, transformed boundary estimates and the nonlinear map remain open.
The original metric return is explicit; no claim is made that the old mixed-source target in a different decomposition has been proved.
